brief: We help independent clinics reduce missed appointments with automated reminders and patient follow-up.
fundraising_goal: Expand the product and sales team.
evidence: The brief states the product reduces missed appointments via reminders and follow-up. No revenue, customer count, or market size is provided.
target_copy:
Independent clinics lose revenue and staff time when appointment reminders and rescheduling are handled manually.

Our platform brings these workflows into one system, helping clinics improve patient communication without adding overhead.

We are starting with small and mid-sized clinics and will use the seed round to expand the product and strengthen distribution.

brief: LedgerNest turns photo receipts from tradespeople into categorized books their accountant can review each week.
fundraising_goal: Finish the accountant workspace and onboard the first bookkeeping partners.
evidence: Product converts receipt photos into categorized books. No customer or revenue figures given.
target_copy:
Tradespeople often photograph receipts and send them in batches, which leaves accountants reconstructing the books by hand.

LedgerNest turns those photos into a weekly categorized ledger the accountant can review without rebuilding the file.

The company is at pre-seed stage and would use new capital to finish the accountant workspace and bring on the first bookkeeping partners.

brief: HarborLane helps mid-size importers track freight exceptions and notify the right warehouse team before a container sits.
fundraising_goal: Hire implementation staff and deepen carrier integrations.
evidence: Focus is exception tracking and warehouse notification. No volume or savings metrics.
target_copy:
When a container is delayed or held, mid-size importers often find out after warehouse labor is already scheduled.

HarborLane tracks freight exceptions and routes the notice to the right warehouse team before the load sits idle.

The seed round would hire implementation staff and deepen carrier integrations.

brief: RivetOps gives HVAC companies one mobile job packet: parts list, site photos, and customer sign-off.
fundraising_goal: Expand onboarding for multi-location operators.
traction: The company reports early use with independent HVAC shops. No revenue figure is stated.
evidence: Job packet includes parts, photos, and sign-off. Traction is described qualitatively only.
target_copy:
HVAC crews still assemble job details across texts, paper work orders, and camera rolls.

RivetOps puts the parts list, site photos, and customer sign-off in one mobile job packet.

The company reports early use with independent HVAC shops and would use a seed round to expand onboarding for multi-location operators.

brief: Oakstack captures daily site logs from voice notes so superintendents do not retype the same update for owners and insurers.
fundraising_goal: Build owner-sharing permissions and train the first regional users.
evidence: Voice notes become daily logs. No insured-loss or time-saved numbers.
target_copy:
Superintendents often retype the same daily update for owners, insurers, and internal chats.

Oakstack turns voice notes into a single site log that can be shared without rewriting the day.

The company is pre-seed and would use funding to build owner-sharing permissions and train the first regional users.

brief: Paperlane keeps grant deadlines, report owners, and required attachments in one calendar for small nonprofits.
fundraising_goal: Add foundation-specific templates and a part-time customer success role.
evidence: Calendar of deadlines, owners, attachments. No AUM or grant-win rates.
target_copy:
Small nonprofits often track grant deadlines in spreadsheets that do not show who owns the next attachment.

Paperlane keeps deadlines, report owners, and required files in one calendar.

Seed funding would add foundation-specific templates and a part-time customer success role.

brief: Saltwell automates recall outreach for independent dental offices using the existing patient list and preferred channel.
fundraising_goal: Support more practice-management exports.
traction: Pilot offices asked for recall reminders after hygiene visits.
evidence: Recall outreach on existing patient lists. No patient counts.
target_copy:
Independent dental offices still run recall lists by hand, which makes it easy to miss hygiene follow-up.

Saltwell sends recall outreach from the existing patient list on the office's preferred channel.

Pilot offices asked for this after hygiene visits. A seed round would support more practice-management exports.

brief: EmberYard turns tomorrow's reservations and 86 list into a prep sheet cooks can check off on a kitchen tablet.
fundraising_goal: Harden offline mode and sell through restaurant groups.
evidence: Prep sheet from reservations and 86 list. No food-cost percentages.
target_copy:
Line cooks often start the day from a verbal 86 list and a reservation printout that is already stale.

EmberYard turns tomorrow's reservations and 86 list into a checkable prep sheet on a kitchen tablet.

The company is pre-seed and would use capital to harden offline mode and sell through restaurant groups.

brief: Willowbank sends families a daily care summary from notes already written by home-care aides, without asking aides to fill a second app.
fundraising_goal: Work with additional home-care agencies on shift-note import.
evidence: Summaries from existing aide notes. No headcount or hour volume.
target_copy:
Families want a daily picture of care, but aides should not be asked to document the same shift twice.

Willowbank writes a family summary from notes the aide already recorded.

Seed funding would help the company work with additional home-care agencies on shift-note import.

brief: BrassNote handles lesson scheduling, makeup credits, and parent messages for independent music schools.
fundraising_goal: Launch billing reminders and a teacher mobile view.
evidence: Scheduling, makeup credits, parent messages. No enrollment numbers.
target_copy:
Independent music schools juggle lesson times, makeup credits, and parent texts in separate threads.

BrassNote keeps scheduling, makeup credits, and parent messages in one place.

The company is pre-seed and would use funding to launch billing reminders and a teacher mobile view.

brief: CopperShift drafts repair estimates from inspection photos and the shop's parts board so advisors spend less time typing.
fundraising_goal: Connect more parts catalogs and train advisor workflows.
evidence: Estimates from photos and parts board. No average-repair-order figures.
target_copy:
Service advisors lose time retyping inspection notes into estimates while the customer waits.

CopperShift drafts the estimate from inspection photos and the shop's parts board.

A seed round would connect more parts catalogs and train advisor workflows.

brief: QuartzPath turns a tutor's session notes into a parent recap and the next-week plan without a new lesson template every time.
fundraising_goal: Add subject packs for high-school math and writing.
evidence: Session notes to recap and plan. No student counts or score lifts.
target_copy:
Tutors already write session notes, then rewrite them as a parent recap and a plan for next week.

QuartzPath produces both from the notes the tutor already captured.

Pre-seed funding would add subject packs for high-school math and writing.

brief: Northfork coordinates CSA box packing lists when members pause, swap, or add a share for one week.
fundraising_goal: Support more pickup sites and a pack-station tablet view.
evidence: Packing lists for pauses, swaps, add-ons. No farm revenue.
target_copy:
CSA farms lose packing time when a member pauses, swaps a box, or adds a share for a single week.

Northfork updates the packing list so the station packs what that week actually requires.

Seed capital would support more pickup sites and a pack-station tablet view.

brief: PactRoom collects matter intake for small firms, then files the answers into the firm's existing document folders.
fundraising_goal: Add conflict-check prompts and matter-type templates.
evidence: Intake into existing folders. No case-volume metrics.
target_copy:
Small firms collect intake in email, then re-enter the same answers into matter folders.

PactRoom gathers the intake and files it into the folders the firm already uses.

The seed round would add conflict-check prompts and matter-type templates.

brief: Millow sequences housekeeping for independent hotels from checkout times and room notes, without replacing the property system.
fundraising_goal: Build a housekeeper-friendly mobile checklist.
evidence: Housekeeping sequence from checkout times and notes. No occupancy rates.
target_copy:
Independent hotels still build the housekeeping board from checkout times written on paper.

Millow sequences rooms from those checkout times and room notes, and it does not replace the property system.

Pre-seed funding would build a housekeeper-friendly mobile checklist.

brief: Tidebench lets chefs place wholesale seafood orders against what the dock actually landed that morning.
fundraising_goal: Add more regional docks and invoice export.
evidence: Orders against landed catch. No GMV.
target_copy:
Chefs order seafood against a catalog that may not match what landed that morning.

Tidebench lets them order against the catch the dock actually has.

Seed funding would add more regional docks and invoice export.

brief: Frostline alerts clinic staff when a cold-chain shipment is delayed so vaccines are not left unattended at receiving.
fundraising_goal: Integrate additional courier status feeds.
evidence: Delay alerts for cold-chain receiving. No dose counts.
target_copy:
Clinic staff may not hear about a delayed cold-chain shipment until a box is sitting at receiving.

Frostline alerts the team when that shipment is late so it is not left unattended.

The company would use a seed round to integrate additional courier status feeds.

brief: DuskRoute plans same-day pharmacy delivery routes around patient time windows and driver shift length.
fundraising_goal: Pilot with independent pharmacies in one metro.
evidence: Routing around time windows and shift length. No delivery-count metrics.
target_copy:
Same-day pharmacy delivery fails when routes ignore patient time windows or the driver's remaining shift.

DuskRoute plans the route around both constraints.

The company is pre-seed and would use funding to pilot with independent pharmacies in one metro.

brief: KilnMail manages class waitlists and clay-studio member firings so the front desk is not rebuilding the list from texts.
fundraising_goal: Add member billing for firings and class packs.
evidence: Waitlists and firing signups. No member counts.
target_copy:
Clay studios rebuild class waitlists and firing signups from text threads at the front desk.

KilnMail keeps waitlists and member firings in one list the desk can trust.

Pre-seed capital would add member billing for firings and class packs.

brief: HarborLane also drafts a short exception note the warehouse can post on the dock board when a container will miss its slot.
fundraising_goal: Hire implementation staff and deepen carrier integrations.
evidence: Second task for the same company: dock-board exception notes. Still no volume metrics.
target_copy:
When a container will miss its slot, the warehouse still needs a short note on the dock board.

HarborLane drafts that exception note from the same tracking event the office already sees.

The seed round would hire implementation staff and deepen carrier integrations.

brief: ClinicFlow is the same product described as a reminder and follow-up workflow for independent clinics that still call patients from a printed schedule.
fundraising_goal: Expand the product and sales team.
evidence: Same company as clinicflow. Printed-schedule calling is in the brief. No metrics.
target_copy:
Independent clinics still call patients from a printed schedule, which makes reminder work slow and easy to skip.

ClinicFlow is a reminder and follow-up workflow for those offices.

The seed round would expand the product and sales team.
